title: Twist Honeydew Melon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Honeydew Melon from Twist E-liquid’s Nic Salt collection captures the refreshing and sweet taste of ripe honeydew melon. This e-liquid offers a light and juicy flavour profile that is perfect for vapers who enjoy fresh and fruity flavours. The natural mellow sweetness of honeydew melon makes this e-liquid an excellent choice for a smooth and satisfying vape. Twist Nic Salt e-liquids are expertly crafted with a balanced 50VG/50PG mix, tailored for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping devices and pod systems. With nicotine strengths of 10mg and 20mg, these e-liquids provide a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine delivery, ideally suited for adult smokers and vapers in search of effective nicotine satisfaction. They are optimised for use in low-wattage MTL devices, including Pod Kits and Starter Kits. Hailing from Los Angeles, the award-winning Twist E-Liquid offers a wide selection of fruit, dessert, and tobacco flavours for adult smokers and vapers seeking an alternative to traditional tobacco products. Known for their authentic flavour profiles, Twist E-Liquid has become a leading brand in the United States. Authorized for sale by the U.S. Food & Drug Administration, Twist have now expanded to the UK and EU, continuing to bring their celebrated flavours to these regions while meeting local regulations and consumer preferences.
